instruction: 优先完成全部扩展代码；每条执行路径用一种固定输入验证生成执行即可，不需要真实权重、其他输入形式或重复验证。继续不做性能测试。
scope: Implement all DNN/MoE extension code and logical correctness. Validate each new execution path once using fixed synthetic weights/inputs and an independent numerical oracle. Do not run real-weight/dataset gates, repeated-process matrices or performance tests. Keep the shared GPU lock. Prior stronger evidence and failures remain recorded.
